requirement.description: The _stream_to_stdin method in SubprocessCLITransport is not correctly implementing the async iterator protocol. Tests fail with "TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine" because the method is returning a coroutine instead of properly yielding values.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method must properly iterate over AsyncIterable prompts and send each message to stdin. It should accept an AsyncIterable[dict] and yield each message as JSON to the stdin stream without blocking or returning coroutines.

requirement.description: The query method in ClaudeSDKClient does not properly handle AsyncIterable prompts. When a prompt is an AsyncIterable, the method tries to iterate over it directly but doesn't properly manage the async iteration flow to send messages to the transport.
requirement.contract: The query method must properly iterate over AsyncIterable prompts and send each message to the transport's send_request method. The method should handle both string and AsyncIterable prompts consistently and correctly.

requirement.description: The process_query method in InternalClient doesn't correctly handle AsyncIterable prompts when passed to SubprocessCLITransport. The async iteration needs to be properly managed to ensure messages are sent to the transport correctly.
requirement.contract: The process_query method must correctly pass AsyncIterable prompts to SubprocessCLITransport and ensure the async iteration is properly handled to send messages to the transport.
